column1: # Tolerances for comparing the stochastic artefacts with the historical, unseeded anchor
# three re-runs each of scripts 5 and 6 plus the anchor (six pairs), approved by Chris on
# 2026-10-09. Rules, set before any candidate result was seen:
#   max_abs, p999_abs, mean_abs: twice the largest value seen across the six pairs;
#     script 5 has a floor of 0.01, the rounding step of its CSV.
#   abs_bias: four standard errors of the mean difference (sd of the per-row differences
#     over the square root of 839,232 rows), because six pairs are too few to estimate it.
# Not used once runs are seeded (issue I04a): seeded comparisons must be byte-identical.
# Changing a value here is a decision for Chris, in its own commit.
